verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a public GitHub repository (github.com/yylo-dev/yylo) whose README documents YYLO's CLI internals, so source appears readable. Nothing in the pack names a license or states it is open source, and the 'open-standard' wording refers only to skill installation. missing for 10: an explicitly named open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), confirmation that the full product source rather than just a README is in the repo, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, repeatable workflows, and receipt-backed repository changes.
